about_the_game:
Heroes For Hire is a business management game focused around building a dungeon raiding guild from the bottom up with the GuildOS system.

Managing a guild isn't going to be as easy as it sounds, though. When running any business, you already have to worry about your employees, your customers, your finances and your living quarters. Just imagine what can go wrong when you start bringing dungeons, fantasy and magic into the picture, too!

Think you have what it takes to run the number one guild in the county? If so, you can compete in tournaments and competitions with rival guilds to determine who really is Raiders Digest's top guild of the week!

Employees are the life blood of any business. After all, how are you going to raid dungeons when you don't have any dungeon raiders on the payroll?

  • Recruit and manage a team of heroes with their set of skills, personality and stats to help them during raids and tournaments.

  • Craft, buy and find equipment and weaponry that can tie-in roles and niches for the team and guild.

  • Make sure to keep the needs of your employees well met by adjusting their wages, schedule and living quarters.


Set up your heroes with the best equipment and items you can find, and go and let them explore some dungeons on their own when they're ready!

  • Make and upgrade your heroes' equipment using materials scavenged in raids and on gathering missions.

  • Craft the necessary tools needed to help your heroes out on their adventures, such as potions and bombs.

  • Build the furniture needed to turn your guild from a shack to a castle fit for a hero of any calibre.

Of course, there's more to running a guild than just the heroes and finances—there's the guild itself, too!

  • Expand your guild's living quarters with furniture that has been bought, found and crafted.

  • Raise your guild's reputation to attract more guest merchants and services with stringent housing requirements.

  • Build more rooms to improve the quality of life for your heroes, and unlock some upgrades at the same time.

Remember, there's always room to grow and expand your guild! So...
detailed_description:
Latest Update

0.10.0.0

Additions:

- Tweaked the Supply Drop to work way more intuitively. It is now crafted with refined fabric, gunpowder and one explosive or healing slime.

- New equipment set! Convict's set. When all 3 items are worn, some of the damage you do will be added to the total money pool at the end of the raid.

- Added a visual indicator for money stolen so far on raids.

Other Changes:

- The game sounds were far quieter than intended before, and that has been adjusted. There also was an issue with clicking that may also be fixed by this.

- The bank now only carries a certain amount of money that can be taken out at a time. This amount goes up over time if you don't take money out.

- Further tightened and smoothed out resizing and moving popups.

- Popup buttons (close, pin, tutorial, minimize, automation) now require RELEASING the mouse button to press. (This is how windows works and I'd like controls to be as similar as possible.)

- Cleaned up some tutorials.

- Tightened the auto team setup again. Also, heroes close to the end of their shift were getting a bonus instead of a penalty when the priority was being decided, and that has been fixed.

- The last colour on the custom colour option is no longer calculated, instead it is now an average of colour 5 and 6.

Balance:

- Fleeing has been rebalanced. Heroes now want to run away more, and have a higher chance to run away.

- Increased barrel bomb damage. (SMALL: 40 -> 60, MEDIUM: 90 -> 120, LARGE: 150 -> 200)

- The cave bear's roar attack now resets the cooldown on the slash attack when used, but has a larger cooldown.

- Cramped In Castle mission: Now requires 6 heroes instead of 8, and a guild reputation of 325.

- Making Ends Meet mission: Now requires a guild hall rating of 2500, and the mission is failed if you have no money in the bank.

- The Big Top mission: Now requires $22500 in the bank to win.

- Wand Skill: Now makes gem activation chance 100%, and will only be used if the wand has a gem in it.

- Bosses in raid orders are now upgraded, with more health and damage.

Bug Fixes:

- Opening item containers no longer count as crafting the items.

- Poisoned enemies that can't attack will no longer attack. (Egg Sacs and Explosive Barrels.)

short_description: You've joined a guild before, right? So, where's the trouble in managing a guild of your own, too? Use the GuildOS system to guide your heroes, raid some dungeons, and grow your guild to rise from the bottom of the ranks right up to the top in Heroes for Hire!
